_about: Round 164: cooking. Fish from the water, meat from beasts, herbs from the garden and the floors become meals that heal and give a buff for a while. A meal is a normal consumable (eat it from the bag); several different meals can be in effect together. Cook in any town, or anywhere with the test kit. A higher survival level stretches how long a meal lasts (+2% a level, up to +50%). Nothing is for sale. (scripts/systems/Cooking.gd)

meals.name: Herb Broth
meals.desc: Slow-simmered and green. Heals 90 HP and mends you steadily for a while.

meals.name: Grilled Cave Carp
meals.desc: Charred over ember root. Heals 70 HP; you hit a little harder for a while.

meals.name: Glowfin Eel Stew
meals.desc: Thick and warming. Heals 120 HP; blows land softer for a while.

meals.name: Moonpetal Dumplings
meals.desc: Light as a held breath. Heals 40 HP; sitting goes deeper for a while.

meals.name: Thistle Roast
meals.desc: Tough and honest. Heals 60 HP; a ward stands round you for a while.

meals.name: Traveller's Plate
meals.desc: Eaten walking. Heals 80 HP; your feet are lighter for a while.

meals.name: Forager's Soup
meals.desc: Smells of the whole meadow. Heals 40 HP; plants give more for a while.

meals.name: Deep Feast
meals.desc: Everything good, at once. Heals 200 HP; you strike harder and finds fall your way for a good while.
